Alger, 27 novembre 2026 (Algeria Tech) —: Algiers, November 27, 2026 (Algeria Tech) — The STREAM brand is introducing its new range of Smart TV Mini LED televisions to the national market, operating on the Google TV 5.0 operating system based on Android 14. This inaugural series combines 4K resolution at 144 Hz, Mini LED backlighting, and a quantum dot filter.
La technologie Mini LED et les innovatio: STREAM's Mini LED technology and audiovisual innovations
La nouvelle gamme de téléviseurs présent: The new range of televisions presented by STREAM integrates innovations designed to improve the visual and sound experience of users in Algeria. Thanks to the combination of Mini LED backlighting and a quantum dot filter, the screens display deeper blacks and brighter colors. The device also incorporates a built-in subwoofer for audio output, Pure Sound clarity, and Dolby Atmos technology on a panel refreshed at 144 Hz.
Du côté logiciel, la mise à jour Google: On the software side, the Google TV 5.0 update, powered by Android 14, brings smoother navigation, enhanced security features, and smart options. Users benefit from the Multi-Profile function allowing personalized recommendations, playlists, and content. Far-Field hands-free voice control makes it possible to use the television without a remote, while Google Cast allows direct content sharing from a mobile phone to the big screen.
La gamme se décline en plusieurs tailles: The range comes in several screen sizes to meet different consumer demands across the following models:
